_note: SRD prestige class requirements (3.5 SRD and the psionic SRD), by the class's English name. They are met before the first level of the class is taken. Fields: race [names]; align (any evil | any good | any lawful | any chaotic | any nonlawful | any nonchaotic | any nongood | any nonevil, or a list of D35E codes); bab; skills {D35E skill key: ranks}; subSkills [{ parent, name, min }] (Perform (dance)); skillsAny { keys, count, min } (any two Knowledge skills); feats [names; 'Name=choice' needs that choice]; anyFeats [one of]; featsFrom { list | metamagic | itemCreation, count } (several of); featCount { feat, count } (one feat with different choices); spells { arcane, divine, any } (able to cast spells of that level), spontaneousArcane, knowsSpells [names], spellSchools { level, count } (spells of that level or higher from that many schools), schoolSpells { school, count, highLevel } (that many spells of a school, one of highLevel or higher); psionics { manifest (power level), ml (manifester level), pp (a power point reserve) }, knowsPowers [names]; sneak (dice); can [classFeature: stillMind]; martial (proficient with all martial weapons); languages [names]; special (not checked: shown as a reminder). A GM's own requirements (Prestige requirements, start page) are kept in the world and replace these.

Assassin.special: The character must kill someone for no other reason than to join the assassins.

Blackguard.special: The character must have made peaceful contact with an evil outsider who was summoned by him or someone else.

Dragon Disciple.special: Any nondragon race (cannot already be a half-dragon). The player chooses a dragon variety when taking the first level.

Psion Uncarnate.special: Must have had some instruction by another psion uncarnate.

Pyrokineticist.special: Must have set fire to a structure of any size just to watch it burn.

War Mind.special: Must have had some instruction by another war mind.
